description.text: Henan University of Technology offers foreign students short-term training course of Chinese culture during the summer vacation. The period of study extends from 2 weeks to 8 weeks. Chinese Language coursesElementary Oral Chinese, Elementary Chinese Listening Cultural CoursesChinese Culture, Chinese History, Chinese Geography, Chinese Movies Cultural Skills CoursesChinese Painting, Chinese Calligraphy, Martial Arts, Chinese Folk Song Courses Courses Class Hours / Week LanguageElementary Oral Chinese 8 Elementary Chinese Listening 4 CultureChinese Culture 4 Chinese History 2 Chinese Geography 2 Chinese Movies 2 CulturalSkillsChinese Painting 2 Chinese Calligraphy 2 Martial Arts 2 Chinese Folk Song 2 Notes: The majors in these colleges are also available for your free choice.

duration.text: The Short-term Training Program at Henan University of Technology is a 8 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 55 USD/per week ￥ 400 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: The applicant should be non-Chinese citizen in the age bracket of 18-50 with good health.
